supported_claim: The exact maximum overlap between a 70-bit cyclic binary sequence and the retained 64-edge common backbone is 61. The repository also independently verifies the reported 71-bit certificate, retains proof-checked local SAT exclusions, and separately labels bounded solver results that have no proof traces.
scoped_result_scope: A graph-theoretic theorem for one project-derived backbone at exact length 70. It is not a new construction, a new bound on L(9,1), or a global impossibility result.

scoped_theorem.statement: Every 70-bit cyclic binary sequence contains at most 61 distinct edges of the retained 64-edge common backbone, and the bound is attained.
scoped_theorem.evidence: A finite residual-flow proof, retained exact enumeration, positive controls, and a tight 70-bit witness.
scoped_theorem.blocker: Focused novelty review and independent external mathematical review remain pending.

global_lower_bound.blocker: Lengths 62 through 70 have not all been excluded by independently checked proofs.

benchmark_artifact.scope: Verified methods, reproduced artifacts, independently checked local DRAT exclusions, separately labeled solver evidence without proof traces, a reduction to nine unresolved cases in the multiplicity-aware overlap-61 shell, the exact common-backbone result, and explicit limitations.
